writeup: Woot has the Fadown Adjustable Volleyball Spike Trainer for $21.99. It adjusts from 28 to 52 inches and uses a patent-pending question-mark hook meant to give a real-ball feel for serving, spiking, and jump training; no ball is included in the box. 24 Volleyball Store lists the same ASIN B0DH7YR75N trainer, with that hook and height range, in stock at $49.99, and Sportium in the UK has the Fadown-branded unit at £83.75, so this is about 56 percent below the lowest verified US comparison and saves $28. Quantity is capped, with at least one left and a limit of one per customer.
